title: LLV-GRF320: a centered fan-in ramp gives n^(16/5) classical space

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the single LLV-GRF320 configuration in proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^((1/2)sqrt nlog2n)), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index1/2. The main branch n>=2^4096 computes v=floor(sqrt n),r=ceil(sqrt n),ell=ceil(log2n),lambda=ceil(6ell/5),H_n=bit_length(n^1024-1),m=floor(25600*(v-256ell)/(25H_n-13312)),kappa=ceil(log2(m+2))+3,A_bar=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*lambda))+2. S(t)=sum_(0<=i<t)floor(5i/6),center=ceil(S(m)/m),fan_i=A_bar+floor(5i/6)-center,fan_max=fan_(m-1). Full widths are(fan_i-1)lambda-kappa; a single finishing call uses k=ceil((R+kappa+1)/lambda),widthR,output log length1. Exact prefix capacity and integer allocation are specified. Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. All source/extraction, serial lookup/list exclusion, circuit/address generation, arithmetic, failed work, discarded copies, measurements, resets and cleanup are charged. Section14 uses deterministic per-level consumed-leaf counts and proves a negative487/51200sqrt n margin with a uniform o(sqrt n) remainder, yielding the exact pure time envelope jointly with all other claims.

For this same LLV-GRF320 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical workspace is O(n^(16/5)) bits with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index0. Since lambda=ceil(6ell/5),2^lambda=O(n^(6/5)); O(n) retained tables each take O(n^(11/5)) bits. Only the current merge keeps its tuple list, of O(n^(11/5)) bits. Current sort/residue arrays use O(n^(27/10)), and profile/prefix data, arithmetic, extraction and streamed decoder data O(n^3) or less. All components fit O(n^(16/5)) without a full stored recursion tree or exponential circuit, jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same LLV-GRF320 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits, with an absolute constant and exact envelope growth index0. Pending siblings use O(lambda*sum_i fan_i)=O(n), and the single finish and each fresh search use O(fan_max*lambda)=O(sqrt(n)log n) additional reusable scratch. Rank/projection, source transforms, extraction, failed branches and cleanup are included. Section8 bounds the profile sum using m*A_bar*lambda<=n+m*kappa+3m*lambda, jointly with unconditional full-secret success and the other claims.

For this same LLV-GRF320 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, all fresh acquired source copies number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Rejected, failed, discarded and aborted copies are included. With Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar, the literal main cap nCcap+K<=2^((1/2)sqrt n) follows from the exact depth rule and H_A=bit_length(A_bar^1024-1). The centered profile has sum fan_i<=m*A_bar, so AM-GM bounds its full product by A_bar^m; every prefix and final arity are covered by fan_max*A_bar^m. Section8 proves mH_A/1024<=(v-256ell)/2 and includes all polynomial cap factors. The finite branch changes only outside constants. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For the same LLV-GRF320 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
